item.title: First-Time Buyer Guide UK 2026: Everything You Need to Know
item.description:
First-Time Buyer Guide UK 2026

Buying your first home is one of the biggest financial decisions you’ll ever make. This guide walks you through every step — from saving a deposit to getting the keys — with links to detailed guides on each topic.

Step 1: Check If You Qualify as a First-Time Buyer

You count as a first-time buyer if you (and anyone you’re buying with) have never owned a property before, whether in the UK or abroad. This qualification unlocks several benefits:
